use_cases: Displaying and selecting between multiple payment product options in a stacked interface
Comparing product features and specifications side by side
Showcasing fintech services like payment processing, crypto, and global transfers
Interactive product catalog with animated card navigation
ai_summary: An interactive card stack component designed for fintech and e-commerce platforms, featuring multiple payment product options displayed in a stacked carousel format. Supports smooth animated transitions between cards, displays product specifications, images, and titles with a clean minimalist design. Ideal for payment method selection interfaces, service comparison views, or product feature showcases with interactive click-to-reveal functionality.
